<export xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly">
    <program>
        <block_set xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly" robottype="edison" xmlversion="3.1" description="" tags="">
            <instance x="20" y="20">
                <block type="robControls_start" id="lf01" intask="true" deletable="false">
                    <mutation declare="false"/>
                    <field name="DEBUG">FALSE</field>
                </block>
                <block type="robControls_loopForever" id="lf10" intask="true">
                    <statement name="DO">
                        <block type="robControls_ifElse" id="lf11" intask="true">
                            <mutation else="1"/>
                            <repetitions>
                                <value name="IF0">
                                    <block type="robSensors_light_getSample" id="lf12" intask="true">
                                        <mutation mode="LINE"/>
                                        <field name="MODE">LINE</field>
                                        <field name="SENSORPORT">LINETRACKER</field>
                                        <field name="SLOT"/>
                                    </block>
                                </value>
                                <statement name="DO0">
                                    <block type="robActions_motorDiff_curve" id="lf13" intask="true">
                                        <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                                        <value name="POWER_LEFT">
                                            <block type="math_number" id="lf14" intask="true">
                                                <field name="NUM">10</field>
                                            </block>
                                        </value>
                                        <value name="POWER_RIGHT">
                                            <block type="math_number" id="lf15" intask="true">
                                                <field name="NUM">40</field>
                                            </block>
                                        </value>
                                    </block>
                                </statement>
                                <statement name="ELSE">
                                    <block type="robActions_motorDiff_curve" id="lf16" intask="true">
                                        <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                                        <value name="POWER_LEFT">
                                            <block type="math_number" id="lf17" intask="true">
                                                <field name="NUM">40</field>
                                            </block>
                                        </value>
                                        <value name="POWER_RIGHT">
                                            <block type="math_number" id="lf18" intask="true">
                                                <field name="NUM">10</field>
                                            </block>
                                        </value>
                                    </block>
                                </statement>
                            </repetitions>
                        </block>
                    </statement>
                </block>
            </instance>
            <instance x="500" y="20">
                <block type="robProcedures_defnoreturn" id="lf30" intask="true">
                    <mutation declare="false"/>
                    <field name="NAME">toTheWall</field>
                    <statement name="STACK">
                        <block type="robActions_motorDiff_on" id="lf31" intask="true">
                            <field name="DIRECTION">FOREWARD</field>
                            <value name="POWER">
                                <block type="math_number" id="lf32" intask="true">
                                    <field name="NUM">40</field>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                        </block>
                        <block type="robControls_wait_for" id="lf33" intask="true">
                            <value name="WAIT0">
                                <block type="logic_compare" id="lf34" intask="true">
                                    <field name="OP">EQ</field>
                                    <value name="A">
                                        <block type="robSensors_getSample" id="lf35" intask="true">
                                            <mutation input="INFRARED_OBSTACLE"/>
                                            <field name="SENSORTYPE">INFRARED_OBSTACLE</field>
                                            <field name="SENSORPORT">FRONT</field>
                                            <field name="SLOT"/>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                    <value name="B">
                                        <block type="logic_boolean" id="lf36" intask="true">
                                            <field name="BOOL">TRUE</field>
                                        </block>
                                    </value>
                                </block>
                            </value>
                        </block>
                        <block type="robActions_motorDiff_stop" id="lf37" intask="true"/>
                    </statement>
                </block>
            </instance>
        </block_set>
    </program>
    <config>
        <block_set xmlns="http://de.fhg.iais.roberta.blockly" robottype="edison" xmlversion="3.1" description="" tags="">
            <instance x="213" y="213">
                <block type="robBrick_Edison-Brick" id="1" intask="true" deletable="false"/>
            </instance>
        </block_set>
    </config>
</export>
